slides.texte_overlay:
small habits of
gentle, calm people

they speak softly

they never raise their voice to be heard. a calm, gentle tone makes people lean in and listen more carefully than they ever would to someone shouting over them.

they feed their mind gently

calm people give their minds something beautiful every day instead of a constant stream of noise. a mind with gentle things to think about has far less room for worry.
slides.texte_sophia:
they feed their mind gently

my mind used to feel loud all day. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a constellation or a painting, and that gentle habit keeps me calm and steady.

slides.texte_overlay:
they move slowly

they walk, eat and talk at an unhurried pace. moving slowly through the day keeps their nervous system calm, and everyone around them seems to relax a little too.

they forgive small things

they let little mistakes and clumsy words go instead of holding on to them. forgiving the small stuff saves their peace for what really matters in life.

they make time for nature

they take a slow walk outside most days, even just around the block. trees, sky and fresh air quietly reset a busy mind better than almost anything else can.
